description: This Java class 'ShippingOption' models shipping options in the application, including attributes like price, name, code, delivery and shipping dates, description, and estimated delivery days. It provides getter and setter methods for these properties and includes logic to parse price information from a text string.

classes.name: ShippingOption
classes.description: Represents a shipping option with attributes such as price, name, code, delivery dates, description, and estimated days. Implements Serializable for persistence.

methods.name: getOptionPrice
methods.description: Returns the shipping option price, parsing it from text if necessary.

methods.name: setOptionCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier for the shipping option.

methods.name: getOptionCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifier of the shipping option.

methods.name: setOptionName
methods.description: Sets the name of the shipping option.

methods.name: getOptionName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the shipping option.

methods.name: setOptionPriceText
methods.description: Sets the price as text, to be parsed later.

methods.name: setOptionId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the shipping option.

methods.name: getOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier of the shipping option.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the shipping option.

methods.name: setEstimatedNumberOfDays
methods.description: Sets the estimated number of days for delivery.

methods.name: getEstimatedNumberOfDays
methods.description: Retrieves the estimated number of days for delivery.
